description: Comment 404 and blank-body fix: the blank-body check matches a single whitespace character only, and the regression test that claims to cover whitespace-only bodies passes for the wrong reason (its fixture makes the article missing, so a 404 satisfies `rejects.toThrowError()`), so whitespace-only comments are still stored.
notes:
FM-18 (verification that verifies), re-seeded (RW-15) so the weak test hides a live wrong outcome. The blank-body check is `/^\s$/` (article.service.ts:474-477), which matches exactly one whitespace character, so a body such as `"  
  "` passes validation and is stored as a blank comment on a real article. The `addComment` tests claim to prove the 422 for that body (`test.each(['', ' ', '  
  '])`, test file 37-39), but the describe block's `beforeEach` mocks `article.findUnique` to null (26-28) and the 422 cases assert only `rejects.toThrowError()`, so the `'  
  '` case passes on the new 404 instead of a 422. Severity important: wrong data persists under normal use (an unmet AC that changes data), and the test plan would make an approver sign off on behavior that isn't there; FM-18 is important when a test gives false confidence on the change's main risk. Fix: give the 422 cases an existing article and assert `rejects.toHaveProperty('errorCode', 422)`, and make the check `!body.trim()` (or `/^\s*$/`). Scored location: the test block (26-39); the regex line in the service (474-477) is an `also` location of the same defect, so a finding on either matches and a second finding on the other is neutral, neither a true nor a false positive: a reviewer who names both fixable defects keeps precision 1. The 404 for a missing article is correct and its test asserts the status.
